facts.fact: The Innovation Hub Management Company runs the Maxum, Climate Innovation Centre, BioPark and eKasiLabs incubators giving business-development support to startups, and reports nine companies graduating from incubation and 389 jobs created through incubated companies in FY2023/24.
The Innovation Hub in Tshwane runs its eKasiLabs incubator programme through micro-innovation hub facilities in Gauteng townships including Soweto, Tembisa, Alexandra, Mamelodi and Sebokeng.
